verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models [ollama-gh-4], with curl, Python and JavaScript access [ollama-docs-9, ollama-docs-10, ollama-docs-11, ollama-docs-19] and a key-based cloud API [ollama-docs-20]. That covers the core chat and model-management workflows. However, nothing establishes parity with the desktop app: UI-driven features such as connecting apps via the macOS Apps menu [ollama-docs-16] have no documented API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify coverage [ollama-probe-3]. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API equivalents for UI-only features such as app connections, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of full coverage.
